title: midjounery 提示词——粉红豹
description:
A pink leopard, with its unique yet lifelike appearance, leaps across dreamlike 3D clouds, creating a romantic, cinematic artistic image in a surreal and aesthetically luxurious photographic style.
一只粉色豹子以其独特而逼真的外形，跃过梦幻般的3D云层，在超现实主义且极具美感的摄影风格下，营造出浪漫、电影般的艺术画面。
